units.source_text: 没有一桩是不可缺少的事件。

en.t: Not a single event was indispensable.

units.source_text: 红砖垒起的，满是缝隙的幻之塔。

en.t: A phantom tower built of red bricks, full of cracks.

units.source_text: 本来嘛，如果净是“不可缺少”的事，

en.t: After all, if everything were indispensable,

units.source_text: 那么，现实就将成为触摸不了的危险的玻璃制品了……

en.t: then reality would become a dangerous glass object that no one could touch...

units.source_text: 总而言之，日常生活就是这么回事……

en.t: In short, that is what everyday life is like...

units.source_text: 所以，尽管谁都知道毫无意思，

en.t: So, even though everyone knows it is utterly meaningless,

units.source_text: 但家庭，仍然占据着圆规的重心。

en.t: the family still occupies the center of gravity of the compass.
